comment: The mapping table of plan f6, step 2 (docs/spec/fsm.md, FSM-B7-6): each error of the legacy vectors (vectors.json) and the kind of the binding that a test of a binding expects in its place. A row applies to a vector whose expected error is from.error and, when the row has from.when, whose input meets that predicate; input_not_int is a from_code input that is no value of the contract int: an input_type (a string, a bool or a float) or an integer outside ±(2^53 − 1). The rows with when come first, and the first row that applies gives the kind; an error that no row maps is a failure of the test.
